product.prompt:
Use case: text-localization image edit. Translate the SINGLE attached Sobrita app screen from Spanish into KOREAN. This is a faithful localization, not a redesign. Preserve the layout, padding, section ordering, all numeric values, product photo, icons, character and room artwork (if present), segmented progress fractions, colors and control sizes. Keep the same portrait mobile viewport ratio390:844 and comparable high-resolution output. App content only; no device bezel, status bar, outer canvas or multiple screens.
Retain "Sobrita" brand wordmark in Latin and retain the URL tienda.example/tenis where shown. KEEP ALL CURRENCY AMOUNTS IN MX$ (Mexican pesos); do NOT convert to Korean won, do NOT change numeric values. Change Spanish words to the exact Korean copy supplied below. No Spanish remnants except the URL path. Preserve commas, math operators, and percentages.
Korean typography is crucial: use a clean highly readable Hangul typeface with a subtle square/pixel-game feel consistent with Sobrita's SobraHangul style. Do not distort Hangul strokes or create pseudo-Korean glyphs. Body readable14–16logicalpx; smaller helper text12–13px only. Keep Latin currency/numbers in the existing blocky style. Korean line wrapping may be adjusted slightly to avoid clipping but do not change content or enlarge compact product cards. Preserve the source's cream#FFFDF7, navy#202848, teal#0E7A72. All prose Korean. All spelling exact, natural Hangul. Current date9November2026 Mexico City; preserve underlying dates, only localize their formatting. Do not add new controls or remove existing controls.

Keep "MX$1,500".
